name: Anju kapoor

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Anju Kapoor is a Bahrain-based poet and visual artist who writes in English and Hindi. The Cultural Reverence published her illustrated poem HER in June 2024, crediting both the verse and the painting to her. Her writing brings the inward life into conversation with images drawn from the natural world.

In Kabita Live’s A Circle - Its Bearing on my Life, the circle expands from the beginnings of life to time, feeling and uncertainty. A butterfly, roots and fruit, and pearls gathered into a necklace carry the poem through successive transformations. The recurring definition of the circle gives these changing images a shared centre.
